recommendation: **CHOOSE APY IF:** You are aged 18–40, NOT a tax-payer, work in the informal sector (self-employed, daily-wage worker, small trader), and want guaranteed pension income starting at age 60. Requires consistent monthly savings discipline. | **CHOOSE PMJDY IF:** You are unbanked, want immediate access to banking services (savings account, debit card, credit), need flexible access to money without withdrawal limits, and want insurance protection. No age restrictions, no minimum balance. | **BOTH COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER:** Many unorganised workers first open a PMJDY account (basic banking), then enrol in APY (long-term pension) using that account for auto-debit.
